The evidence is consistent with a mechanism involving the regulation of a G-protein coupled receptor or a related signaling pathway, which could influence the cotransporter's function. The integration of these pathways supports the hypothesis that Abiesadine J may act as a modulator of the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact mechanism and the role of the intermediaries involved.
